props.name: onMove
props.description: Called with the vector whenever it changes, and every frame while held if `continuous` is on.

props.name: onEnd
props.description: Called once when the stick is released and springs back.

props.name: mode
props.description: `analog` reports any angle; `dpad4` and `dpad8` snap to four or eight directions.

props.name: deadZone
props.description: Fraction of the radius, 0–1, that reads as centred. Stops drift from a resting thumb.

props.name: continuous
props.description: Report the vector every animation frame while held, not only on change — what a game loop wants.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the base in pixels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
